name: Agent Deep Modeling

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.tsx"
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.module.css"
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/SessionsNewPage.tsx"
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/SessionsNewPage.module.css"
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/SessionFormContainer.tsx"
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/SessionHistorySection.tsx"
      - "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/EmptyState.tsx"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  agent-deep-modeling:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-setup

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run linting
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build application
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Verify visual consistency
        run: |
          echo "Verifying visual consistency between ProjectSessionsPage and SessionsNewPage..."
          
          # Check if required files exist
          if [ ! -f "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.tsx" ]; then
            echo "Error: ProjectSessionsPage not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ ! -f "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/SessionsNewPage.tsx" ]; then
            echo "Error: SessionsNewPage not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if CSS files exist
          if [ ! -f "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.module.css" ]; then
            echo "Error: ProjectSessionsPage CSS not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ ! -f "frontend/apps/app/src/components/sessions/SessionsNewPage.module.css" ]; then
            echo "Error: SessionsNewPage CSS not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All required files present for visual consistency verification"
          
          # Verify key styling elements are aligned
          echo "Checking layout structure alignment..."
          # Check for center-aligned 782px wrapper in ProjectSessionsPage
          if ! grep -q "782px" "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.module.css"; then
            echo "Warning: 782px width constraint not found in ProjectSessionsPage CSS"
          fi
          
          # Check for center-aligned title in ProjectSessionsPage
          if ! grep -q "center" "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.module.css" || ! grep -q "52px" "frontend/apps/app/src/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/sessions/page.module.css"; then
            echo "Warning: Center-aligned 52px title not found in ProjectSessionsPage CSS"
          fi
          
          echo "Visual consistency verification completed"
